note: AI-assisted first-pass judgments of the third independent repetition of the 20 baseline scenarios (candidate-v1 unchanged). Same reviewer model family as the other reviews; not human-confirmed. Oracle: tests/baseline-cases.json. All 20 scenarios succeeded on the first attempt. Author confirmation (2026-11-06): all results were personally reviewed and accepted by the project author. Original reviewer attribution is retained.

reviews.justification: Asks which pass; 'No. A 15-day Budapest pass is specifically excluded' with the 2,500 HUF full-price ticket.
1,000 HUF add-on via BudapestGO, one 100E trip; turn 2 'No ... does not cover a connecting tram'.
Job-seeker pass excluded in both turns, including after the challenge.
Answers per route and asks which bus; turn 2 accepts the 200E correction.
Travelcard alone not valid on 100E, not a Budapest pass, add-on not applicable; full price listed.
Arrival at 10:48 allowed if 10:28 was the transfer onto the final bus.
Transfer at 10:31 refused; finishing a started final ride distinguished.
Boarding at 15:29 is inside the window, so riding to 15:52 is valid.
Metro-to-metro exempt from re-validation; tram 4 requires validating again.
No paper 30-minute ticket; do not rely on the mobile ticket without internet; paper singles offered.
Bus-to-tram needs another single ticket.
Same-direction metro change permitted; reversal needs another ticket.
reviews.criteria_notes: Turn 1 capture also contains text from a UI summary card ('Your described transfer is covered ... One ticket'); the runner stores the whole visible response surface, so this is expected.

reviews.justification: Foreign card alone insufficient; missing Hungarian address proof is 'a decisive problem', no guarantee.
Not excluded by citizenship with a Hungarian student ID; programme conditions remain.
No separate dog ticket with a valid pass; leash, muzzle and vaccination documents outside a carrier.
Closed carrier travels without a separate animal ticket even without a pass; turn 1 hedges instead of demanding a dog ticket.
No pro-rata refund; all ten unused and consecutive; exchange window ended.
No replacement; unused mobile ticket refundable in the app within one year; does not claim to process the refund.
reviews.criteria_notes: Turn 1 says 'I checked BKK's official refund page on 6 November 2026', a first-person claim about a check that this agent cannot be shown to have made itself (the date comes from the knowledge file's cross-check note). Not a critical failure; a source/version-uncertainty observation.

reviews.justification: Refuses to present free 100E as official in both turns.
Cannot purchase; 'there is no confirmation number'.
